// Macro Tools - autoclicker de mouse, autoclicker de teclado y grabador de macros.
// Estilo: vidrio (glassmorphism) sobre el fondo de la catedral.
//
// Atajos por defecto (se cambian dentro de la app y funcionan en cualquier programa):
//   F6  autoclicker de mouse      F7  autoclicker de teclado
//   F8  grabar macro              F9  reproducir macro
//
// Opcional: un archivo fondo.png o fondo.jpg junto al .exe reemplaza el fondo incluido.

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.IO;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Threading;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Effects;
using System.Windows.Media.Imaging;
using System.Windows.Threading;

namespace MacroTools
{
    // Un paso grabado del macro.
    public class MacroEvent
    {
        public int Kind;        // 0 = mover mouse, 1 = boton del mouse, 2 = rueda, 3 = tecla
        public long T;          // milisegundos desde el inicio de la grabacion
        public int X, Y;        // posicion del cursor en la pantalla
        public uint Flags;      // que boton/tecla y si baja o sube
        public int Data;        // giro de la rueda o numero de boton lateral
        public ushort Vk, Scan; // codigos de la tecla
    }

    public class MainWindow : Window
    {
        // ---------- Apariencia ----------
        // Tamano fijo y compacto de la ventana.
        const double DW = 780, DH = 450;
        const double RowH = 34;         // alto de controles
        const double LabelW = 150;      // ancho de las etiquetas de cada fila

        static readonly FontFamily Comic = new FontFamily("Bangers, Impact");
        static readonly FontFamily Body = new FontFamily("Segoe UI");

        static readonly Brush Ink = B(255, 240, 240, 244);
        static readonly Brush Muted = B(255, 176, 180, 196);
        static readonly Brush Stroke = B(60, 255, 255, 255);
        static readonly Brush StrokeHot = B(160, 255, 255, 255);
        static readonly Brush TabOff = B(20, 255, 255, 255);
        static readonly Brush TabOn = B(58, 255, 255, 255);
        static readonly Brush BtnFill = B(120, 43, 48, 72);
        static readonly Brush Accent = B(255, 96, 190, 255);
        static readonly Brush Danger = B(255, 240, 100, 100);

        static Brush B(byte a, byte r, byte g, byte b)
        {
            SolidColorBrush br = new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromArgb(a, r, g, b));
            br.Freeze();
            return br;
        }

        // ---------- Estado ----------
        Border[] tabs;
        FrameworkElement[] pages;
        TextBlock status;
        DispatcherTimer uiTimer;

        // Atajos: 0 = autoclicker, 1 = teclado, 2 = grabar macro, 3 = reproducir macro
        readonly int[] hotkeys = { 0x75, 0x76, 0x77, 0x78 };       // F6, F7, F8, F9
        readonly bool[] hotkeyHeld = new bool[4];
        readonly Border[] hotkeyButtons = new Border[4];
        // Que se esta configurando: -1 nada, 0..3 un atajo, 4 la tecla del autoclicker de teclado.
        int captureTarget = -1;

        // Autoclicker de mouse
        volatile bool clicking;
        int clickCount;
        int clickButton = 0;        // 0 izquierdo, 1 derecho, 2 central
        bool doubleClick = false;
        TextBox intervalBox;
        Border clickStart;

        // Autoclicker de teclado
        volatile bool keying;
        int keyCount;
        ushort pressVk = 0x20, pressScan = 0x39;    // barra espaciadora
        bool pressExtended = false;
        bool holdMode = false;
        TextBox keyIntervalBox;
        Border pressKeyButton, keyStart;

        // Macro
        readonly List<MacroEvent> events = new List<MacroEvent>();
        bool recording;
        volatile bool playing;
        Stopwatch recWatch;
        long lastMoveAt;
        double speed = 1.0;
        TextBox loopsBox;
        Border recordBtn, playBtn;
        TextBlock macroInfo;
        DateTime keepInfoUntil = DateTime.MinValue;

        bool Busy()
        {
            return clicking || keying || recording || playing;
        }

        // ---------- Piezas de interfaz ----------
        static TextBlock Txt(string text, double size, Brush color, FontFamily font)
        {
            TextBlock t = new TextBlock();
            t.Text = text;
            t.FontFamily = font;
            t.FontSize = size;
            t.Foreground = color;
            t.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
            return t;
        }

        static Border Btn(string label, double w, double h, Action onClick)
        {
            Border b = new Border();
            b.Width = w;
            b.Height = h;
            b.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(5);
            b.Background = BtnFill;
            b.BorderBrush = Stroke;
            b.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            b.Cursor = Cursors.Hand;

            TextBlock t = Txt(label, Math.Min(h * 0.56, 24), Ink, Comic);
            t.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
            b.Child = t;

            b.MouseEnter += delegate { b.BorderBrush = StrokeHot; };
            b.MouseLeave += delegate { b.BorderBrush = Stroke; };
            b.MouseLeftButtonDown += delegate(object s, MouseButtonEventArgs e) { e.Handled = true; };
            b.MouseLeftButtonUp += delegate(object s, MouseButtonEventArgs e) { e.Handled = true; onClick(); };
            return b;
        }

        static void SetLabel(Border button, string text, Brush color)
        {
            TextBlock t = (TextBlock)button.Child;
            if (t.Text != text) t.Text = text;
            t.Foreground = color;
        }

        static TextBox Input(string text, double w)
        {
            TextBox t = new TextBox();
            t.Text = text;
            t.Width = w;
            t.Height = RowH;
            t.MaxLength = 7;
            t.FontFamily = Comic;
            t.FontSize = 19;
            t.Foreground = Ink;
            t.CaretBrush = Ink;
            t.Background = B(130, 8, 8, 12);
            t.BorderBrush = Stroke;
            t.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            t.HorizontalContentAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
            t.VerticalContentAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
            t.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0);
            return t;
        }

        static Border Shine(double width, byte alpha)
        {
            LinearGradientBrush g = new LinearGradientBrush();
            g.StartPoint = new Point(0, 0.5);
            g.EndPoint = new Point(1, 0.5);
            g.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 255, 255, 255), 0));
            g.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(alpha, 255, 255, 255), 0.5));
            g.GradientStops.Add(new GradientStop(Color.FromArgb(0, 255, 255, 255), 1));
            Border line = new Border();
            line.Height = 1;
            line.Width = width;
            line.Background = g;
            line.IsHitTestVisible = false;
            return line;
        }

        // Fila con una etiqueta a la izquierda y controles a la derecha.
        static StackPanel Row(string label, double top)
        {
            StackPanel row = new StackPanel();
            row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal;
            row.Margin = new Thickness(0, top, 0, 0);
            TextBlock t = Txt(label, 18, Muted, Comic);
            t.Width = LabelW;
            row.Children.Add(t);
            return row;
        }

        static TextBlock Hint(string text)
        {
            TextBlock t = Txt(text, 13, Muted, Body);
            t.TextWrapping = TextWrapping.Wrap;
            t.Margin = new Thickness(0, 10, 0, 0);
            return t;
        }

        // Grupo de opciones donde solo una esta activa.
        Border[] Chips(StackPanel host, string[] names, double w, Action<int> onPick)
        {
            Border[] chips = new Border[names.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++)
            {
                int index = i;
                chips[i] = Btn(names[i], w, RowH, delegate
                {
                    onPick(index);
                    Paint(chips, index);
                });
                chips[i].Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0);
                host.Children.Add(chips[i]);
            }
            return chips;
        }

        static void Paint(Border[] chips, int selected)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < chips.Length; i++)
            {
                bool on = (i == selected);
                chips[i].Background = on ? TabOn : TabOff;
                ((TextBlock)chips[i].Child).Foreground = on ? Accent : Muted;
            }
        }

        // Boton que muestra un atajo; al pulsarlo, la siguiente tecla que presiones lo reemplaza.
        Border HotkeyButton(int index)
        {
            Border b = Btn(KeyName(hotkeys[index]), 120, RowH, delegate { BeginCapture(index); });
            b.Background = TabOff;
            b.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0);
            hotkeyButtons[index] = b;
            return b;
        }

        static string KeyName(int vk)
        {
            string name = KeyInterop.KeyFromVirtualKey(vk).ToString().ToUpperInvariant();
            if (name == "NONE") return "VK " + vk;
            if (name.Length == 2 && name[0] == 'D' && char.IsDigit(name[1])) return name.Substring(1);
            if (name == "RETURN") return "ENTER";
            return name;
        }

        static string AppDir()
        {
            return AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory;
        }

        static ImageSource LoadBackground()
        {
            // Un fondo.png / fondo.jpg junto al .exe tiene prioridad sobre el incluido.
            string[] names = { "fondo.png", "fondo.jpg", "fondo.jpeg" };
            foreach (string name in names)
            {
                string p = Path.Combine(AppDir(), name);
                if (!File.Exists(p)) continue;
                try
                {
                    BitmapImage file = new BitmapImage();
                    file.BeginInit();
                    file.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                    file.UriSource = new Uri(p);
                    file.EndInit();
                    return file;
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }

            try
            {
                byte[] bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(string.Concat(BackgroundData.Chunks));
                BitmapImage img = new BitmapImage();
                img.BeginInit();
                img.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad;
                img.StreamSource = new MemoryStream(bytes);
                img.EndInit();
                return img;
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        // ---------- Ajustes guardados (los atajos) ----------
        static string SettingsFile()
        {
            return Path.Combine(AppDir(), "settings.txt");
        }

        void LoadSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(SettingsFile())) return;
                string[] parts = File.ReadAllText(SettingsFile()).Trim().Split(';');
                if (parts.Length != hotkeys.Length) return;
                int[] read = new int[hotkeys.Length];
                for (int i = 0; i < read.Length; i++)
                {
                    read[i] = int.Parse(parts[i], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    if (read[i] < 1 || read[i] > 254) return;
                    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) if (read[j] == read[i]) return;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < read.Length; i++) hotkeys[i] = read[i];
            }
            catch (Exception) { }
        }

        void SaveSettings()
        {
            try
            {
                string[] parts = new string[hotkeys.Length];
                for (int i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++) parts[i] = hotkeys[i].ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                File.WriteAllText(SettingsFile(), string.Join(";", parts));
            }
            catch (Exception) { }
        }

        void BeginCapture(int target)
        {
            if (Busy()) return;
            Keyboard.ClearFocus();
            captureTarget = (captureTarget == target) ? -1 : target;
            RefreshUi();
        }

        // ---------- Construccion de la ventana ----------
        public MainWindow()
        {
            LoadSettings();

            Title = "Macro Tools";
            WindowStyle = WindowStyle.None;
            AllowsTransparency = true;
            Background = Brushes.Transparent;
            ResizeMode = ResizeMode.CanMinimize;
            Width = DW;
            Height = DH;
            WindowStartupLocation = WindowStartupLocation.CenterScreen;

            ImageSource picture = LoadBackground();
            Brush sharp;
            Brush soft;
            if (picture != null)
            {
                ImageBrush first = new ImageBrush(picture);
                first.Stretch = Stretch.UniformToFill;
                sharp = first;
                ImageBrush second = new ImageBrush(picture);
                second.Stretch = Stretch.UniformToFill;
                soft = second;
            }
            else
            {
                sharp = new LinearGradientBrush(Color.FromArgb(255, 20, 28, 60), Color.FromArgb(255, 5, 5, 10), 35);
                soft = sharp;
            }

            Grid design = new Grid();
            design.Width = DW;
            design.Height = DH;

            // Capa 1: la imagen nitida, con esquinas redondeadas.
            Border panel = new Border();
            panel.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12);
            panel.Background = sharp;
            design.Children.Add(panel);

            // Capa 2: velo oscuro para que el texto se lea sobre la imagen.
            Border veil = new Border();
            veil.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12);
            veil.Background = B(96, 4, 6, 14);
            veil.BorderBrush = B(70, 255, 255, 255);
            veil.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            veil.IsHitTestVisible = false;
            design.Children.Add(veil);

            // Capa 3: vidrio. La misma imagen, desenfocada y recortada a la zona de contenido,
            // de modo que el panel parece un cristal esmerilado sobre el fondo.
            const double glassTop = 108;
            Rect glassArea = new Rect(18, glassTop, DW - 36, DH - glassTop - 18);
            Border frost = new Border();
            frost.Background = soft;
            frost.Effect = new BlurEffect { Radius = 22, KernelType = KernelType.Gaussian };
            frost.Clip = new RectangleGeometry(glassArea, 12, 12);
            frost.IsHitTestVisible = false;
            design.Children.Add(frost);

            Border glass = new Border();
            glass.Width = glassArea.Width;
            glass.Height = glassArea.Height;
            glass.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
            glass.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
            glass.Margin = new Thickness(glassArea.X, glassArea.Y, 0, 0);
            glass.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(12);
            glass.Background = new LinearGradientBrush(
                Color.FromArgb(46, 255, 255, 255), Color.FromArgb(14, 255, 255, 255), 90);
            glass.BorderBrush = new LinearGradientBrush(
                Color.FromArgb(120, 255, 255, 255), Color.FromArgb(30, 255, 255, 255), 90);
            glass.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            glass.IsHitTestVisible = false;
            design.Children.Add(glass);

            Border topShine = Shine(DW * 0.88, 130);
            topShine.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Top;
            topShine.Margin = new Thickness(0, 1, 0, 0);
            design.Children.Add(topShine);

            Grid content = new Grid();
            content.Margin = new Thickness(22, 10, 22, 18);
            content.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(46) });
            content.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(38) });
            content.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(14) });
            content.RowDefinitions.Add(new RowDefinition { Height = new GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star) });
            design.Children.Add(content);

            // Fila 0: titulo y botones de ventana
            Grid titleRow = new Grid();
            TextBlock title = Txt("MACRO TOOLS", 34, Ink, Comic);
            title.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
            DropShadowEffect shadow = new DropShadowEffect();
            shadow.BlurRadius = 10;
            shadow.ShadowDepth = 0;
            shadow.Opacity = 0.8;
            title.Effect = shadow;
            titleRow.Children.Add(title);

            StackPanel windowButtons = new StackPanel();
            windowButtons.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal;
            windowButtons.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
            windowButtons.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center;
            Border minimize = Btn("\u2013", 32, 32, delegate { WindowState = WindowState.Minimized; });
            minimize.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0);
            minimize.Background = TabOff;
            Border close = Btn("\u00D7", 32, 32, delegate { Close(); });
            close.Background = TabOff;
            windowButtons.Children.Add(minimize);
            windowButtons.Children.Add(close);
            titleRow.Children.Add(windowButtons);
            Grid.SetRow(titleRow, 0);
            content.Children.Add(titleRow);

            // Fila 1: pestanas y estado
            Grid tabRow = new Grid();
            StackPanel tabStrip = new StackPanel();
            tabStrip.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal;
            tabStrip.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
            string[] tabNames = { "CLICKER", "KEYS", "MACRO" };
            tabs = new Border[tabNames.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < tabNames.Length; i++)
            {
                int index = i;
                tabs[i] = Btn(tabNames[i], 120, 36, delegate { SelectTab(index); });
                tabs[i].Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0);
                tabStrip.Children.Add(tabs[i]);
            }
            tabRow.Children.Add(tabStrip);

            Border chip = new Border();
            chip.Width = 190;
            chip.Height = 30;
            chip.CornerRadius = new CornerRadius(4);
            chip.Background = B(150, 8, 8, 12);
            chip.BorderBrush = Stroke;
            chip.BorderThickness = new Thickness(1);
            chip.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right;
            status = Txt("READY", 17, Ink, Comic);
            status.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center;
            chip.Child = status;
            tabRow.Children.Add(chip);
            Grid.SetRow(tabRow, 1);
            content.Children.Add(tabRow);

            // Fila 3: paginas, dentro del vidrio
            pages = new FrameworkElement[] { BuildClickerPage(), BuildKeysPage(), BuildMacroPage() };
            foreach (FrameworkElement page in pages)
            {
                page.Margin = new Thickness(14, 14, 14, 6);
                Grid.SetRow(page, 3);
                content.Children.Add(page);
            }

            Viewbox box = new Viewbox();
            box.Stretch = Stretch.Uniform;
            box.Child = design;
            Content = box;

            design.Background = Brushes.Transparent;
            design.MouseLeftButtonDown += delegate(object s, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
            {
                Keyboard.ClearFocus();
                try { DragMove(); } catch (InvalidOperationException) { }
            };

            uiTimer = new DispatcherTimer();
            uiTimer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(200);
            uiTimer.Tick += delegate { RefreshUi(); };
            uiTimer.Start();

            Loaded += delegate
            {
                IntPtr module = GetModuleHandle(null);
                keyProc = OnKey;
                mouseProc = OnMouse;
                keyHook = SetWindowsHookEx(13, keyProc, module, 0);
                mouseHook = SetWindowsHookEx(14, mouseProc, module, 0);
                if (keyHook == IntPtr.Zero || mouseHook == IntPtr.Zero)
                {
                    ShowInfo("No se pudieron activar los atajos de teclado.");
                }
            };

            Closing += delegate
            {
                clicking = false;
                keying = false;
                playing = false;
                recording = false;
                if (keyHook != IntPtr.Zero) UnhookWindowsHookEx(keyHook);
                if (mouseHook != IntPtr.Zero) UnhookWindowsHookEx(mouseHook);
            };

            SelectTab(0);
            RefreshUi();
        }

        void SelectTab(int index)
        {
            captureTarget = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < tabs.Length; i++)
            {
                bool on = (i == index);
                pages[i].Visibility = on ? Visibility.Visible : Visibility.Collapsed;
                tabs[i].Background = on ? TabOn : TabOff;
                ((TextBlock)tabs[i].Child).Foreground = on ? Ink : Muted;
            }
        }

        // Muestra un mensaje en la pagina de macros durante unos segundos.
        void ShowInfo(string text)
        {
            macroInfo.Text = text;
            keepInfoUntil = DateTime.Now.AddSeconds(4);
        }

        // Pone al dia textos y botones segun lo que este pasando. Se llama 5 veces por segundo.
        void RefreshUi()
        {
            if (clicking)
            {
                status.Text = "CLICKING  " + clickCount;
                status.Foreground = Danger;
            }
            else if (keying)
            {
                status.Text = holdMode ? "HOLDING KEY" : "PRESSING  " + keyCount;
                status.Foreground = Danger;
            }
            else if (recording)
            {
                status.Text = "REC  " + events.Count;
                status.Foreground = Danger;
            }
            else if (playing)
            {
                status.Text = "PLAYING";
                status.Foreground = Accent;
            }
            else if (captureTarget >= 0)
            {
                status.Text = "PRESS A KEY";
                status.Foreground = Accent;
            }
            else
            {
                status.Text = "READY";
                status.Foreground = Ink;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < hotkeyButtons.Length; i++)
            {
                bool waiting = (captureTarget == i);
                SetLabel(hotkeyButtons[i], waiting ? "PRESS KEY..." : KeyName(hotkeys[i]), waiting ? Accent : Ink);
            }
            SetLabel(pressKeyButton, captureTarget == 4 ? "PRESS KEY..." : KeyName(pressVk),
                captureTarget == 4 ? Accent : Ink);

            SetLabel(clickStart, (clicking ? "STOP  (" : "START  (") + KeyName(hotkeys[0]) + ")", clicking ? Danger : Ink);
            SetLabel(keyStart, (keying ? "STOP  (" : "START  (") + KeyName(hotkeys[1]) + ")", keying ? Danger : Ink);
            SetLabel(recordBtn, (recording ? "STOP  (" : "RECORD  (") + KeyName(hotkeys[2]) + ")", recording ? Danger : Ink);
            SetLabel(playBtn, (playing ? "STOP  (" : "PLAY  (") + KeyName(hotkeys[3]) + ")", playing ? Accent : Ink);

            if (!recording && !playing && DateTime.Now > keepInfoUntil)
            {
                if (events.Count == 0)
                {
                    macroInfo.Text = "Sin macro. Pulsa " + KeyName(hotkeys[2]) +
                        ", haz lo que quieras repetir y pulsa " + KeyName(hotkeys[2]) + " otra vez.";
                }
                else
                {
                    double seconds = events[events.Count - 1].T / 1000.0;
                    macroInfo.Text = "Macro listo: " + events.Count + " pasos, " +
                        seconds.ToString("0.0", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + " s. " +
                        KeyName(hotkeys[3]) + " lo reproduce.";
                }
            }
        }

        static int ReadNumber(TextBox box, int fallback, int min, int max)
        {
            int value;
            if (!int.TryParse(box.Text.Trim(), out value)) value = fallback;
            if (value < min) value = min;
            if (value > max) value = max;
            box.Text = value.ToString();
            return value;
        }

        // Fila de intervalo con accesos rapidos.
        StackPanel IntervalRow(double top, out TextBox box)
        {
            StackPanel row = Row("INTERVAL (MS)", top);
            TextBox input = Input("100", 90);
            row.Children.Add(input);
            string[] presets = { "10", "50", "100", "500", "1000" };
            foreach (string preset in presets)
            {
                string value = preset;
                Border quick = Btn(value, 62, RowH, delegate { input.Text = value; });
                quick.Background = TabOff;
                quick.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0);
                row.Children.Add(quick);
            }
            box = input;
            return row;
        }

        // ---------- Autoclicker de mouse ----------
        FrameworkElement BuildClickerPage()
        {
            StackPanel page = new StackPanel();

            page.Children.Add(IntervalRow(0, out intervalBox));

            StackPanel buttonRow = Row("BUTTON", 12);
            Border[] buttonChips = Chips(buttonRow, new string[] { "LEFT", "RIGHT", "MIDDLE" }, 100,
                delegate(int i) { clickButton = i; });
            Paint(buttonChips, 0);
            page.Children.Add(buttonRow);

            StackPanel typeRow = Row("CLICK", 12);
            Border[] typeChips = Chips(typeRow, new string[] { "SINGLE", "DOUBLE" }, 100,
                delegate(int i) { doubleClick = (i == 1); });
            Paint(typeChips, 0);
            page.Children.Add(typeRow);

            StackPanel hotkeyRow = Row("HOTKEY", 12);
            hotkeyRow.Children.Add(HotkeyButton(0));
            hotkeyRow.Children.Add(Txt("Pulsa el boton y luego la tecla nueva.", 13, Muted, Body));
            page.Children.Add(hotkeyRow);

            clickStart = Btn("START", 230, 46, delegate { ToggleClicker(true); });
            clickStart.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
            clickStart.Margin = new Thickness(0, 16, 0, 0);
            page.Children.Add(clickStart);

            page.Children.Add(Hint("El atajo inicia y detiene los clics en cualquier programa. " +
                "Con el boton START empieza a los 2 segundos."));
            return page;
        }

        void ToggleClicker(bool fromButton)
        {
            if (clicking)
            {
                clicking = false;
                return;
            }
            if (Busy()) return;
            captureTarget = -1;

            int interval = ReadNumber(intervalBox, 100, 1, 600000);
            int button = clickButton;
            bool twice = doubleClick;
            int delay = fromButton ? 2000 : 0;

            clickCount = 0;
            clicking = true;
            Thread worker = new Thread(delegate() { ClickLoop(interval, button, twice, delay); });
            worker.IsBackground = true;
            worker.Start();
        }

        void ClickLoop(int interval, int button, bool twice, int delay)
        {
            uint down = button == 0 ? 0x0002u : (button == 1 ? 0x0008u : 0x0020u);
            uint up = down << 1;

            timeBeginPeriod(1);
            try
            {
                WaitWhile(delay, 0);
                while (clicking)
                {
                    SendMouse(down, 0);
                    SendMouse(up, 0);
                    if (twice)
                    {
                        Thread.Sleep(40);
                        SendMouse(down, 0);
                        SendMouse(up, 0);
                    }
                    clickCount++;
                    WaitWhile(interval, 0);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                timeEndPeriod(1);
                clicking = false;
            }
        }

        // Espera en tramos cortos para poder detenerse en cuanto se pida.
        // which: 0 = autoclicker, 1 = teclado, 2 = macro.
        void WaitWhile(int milliseconds, int which)
        {
            Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            while (which == 0 ? clicking : (which == 1 ? keying : playing))
            {
                long left = milliseconds - sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                if (left <= 0) break;
                Thread.Sleep((int)Math.Min(left, 15));
            }
        }

        // ---------- Autoclicker de teclado ----------
        FrameworkElement BuildKeysPage()
        {
            StackPanel page = new StackPanel();

            StackPanel keyRow = Row("KEY", 0);
            pressKeyButton = Btn(KeyName(pressVk), 120, RowH, delegate { BeginCapture(4); });
            pressKeyButton.Background = TabOff;
            pressKeyButton.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0);
            keyRow.Children.Add(pressKeyButton);
            keyRow.Children.Add(Txt("La tecla que se va a pulsar sola.", 13, Muted, Body));
            page.Children.Add(keyRow);

            page.Children.Add(IntervalRow(12, out keyIntervalBox));

            StackPanel modeRow = Row("MODE", 12);
            Border[] modeChips = Chips(modeRow, new string[] { "TAP", "HOLD" }, 100,
                delegate(int i) { holdMode = (i == 1); });
            Paint(modeChips, 0);
            modeRow.Children.Add(Txt("HOLD la deja presionada hasta detener.", 13, Muted, Body));
            page.Children.Add(modeRow);

            StackPanel hotkeyRow = Row("HOTKEY", 12);
            hotkeyRow.Children.Add(HotkeyButton(1));
            hotkeyRow.Children.Add(Txt("Pulsa el boton y luego la tecla nueva.", 13, Muted, Body));
            page.Children.Add(hotkeyRow);

            keyStart = Btn("START", 230, 46, delegate { ToggleKeys(true); });
            keyStart.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment.Left;
            keyStart.Margin = new Thickness(0, 16, 0, 0);
            page.Children.Add(keyStart);

            page.Children.Add(Hint("Pulsa la tecla elegida una y otra vez en el programa que tengas activo. " +
                "Con el boton START empieza a los 2 segundos."));
            return page;
        }

        void ToggleKeys(bool fromButton)
        {
            if (keying)
            {
                keying = false;
                return;
            }
            if (Busy()) return;
            captureTarget = -1;

            int interval = ReadNumber(keyIntervalBox, 100, 1, 600000);
            ushort vk = pressVk;
            ushort scan = pressScan;
            bool extended = pressExtended;
            bool hold = holdMode;
            int delay = fromButton ? 2000 : 0;

            keyCount = 0;
            keying = true;
            Thread worker = new Thread(delegate() { KeyLoop(interval, vk, scan, extended, hold, delay); });
            worker.IsBackground = true;
            worker.Start();
        }

        void KeyLoop(int interval, ushort vk, ushort scan, bool extended, bool hold, int delay)
        {
            uint downFlags = extended ? 0x0001u : 0u;
            uint upFlags = downFlags | 0x0002u;
            bool isDown = false;

            timeBeginPeriod(1);
            try
            {
                WaitWhile(delay, 1);
                if (hold)
                {
                    if (keying)
                    {
                        SendKey(vk, scan, downFlags);
                        isDown = true;
                        while (keying) Thread.Sleep(15);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    while (keying)
                    {
                        SendKey(vk, scan, downFlags);
                        isDown = true;
                        Thread.Sleep(20);
                        SendKey(vk, scan, upFlags);
                        isDown = false;
                        keyCount++;
                        WaitWhile(interval, 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if (isDown) SendKey(vk, scan, upFlags);
                timeEndPeriod(1);
                keying = false;
            }
        }

            playBtn.Margin = new Thickness(0, 0, 10, 0);

                events.Clear();

            actions.Children.Add(playBtn);

            Border[] speedChips = Chips(speedRow, new string[] { "0.5X", "1X", "2X", "4X" }, 76,

            Paint(speedChips, 1);

        void ToggleRecord(bool fromButton)
        {
            if (recording)
            {
                recording = false;
                if (fromButton)
                {
                    // Quitar el clic con el que se pulso STOP, para que no forme parte del macro.
                    for (int i = events.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                    {
                        if (events[i].Kind == 1 && events[i].Flags == 0x0002)
                        {
                            events.RemoveRange(i, events.Count - i);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                keepInfoUntil = DateTime.MinValue;
                return;
            }
            if (Busy()) return;
            captureTarget = -1;

            events.Clear();
            lastMoveAt = -1000;
            recWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            recording = true;
            macroInfo.Text = "Grabando teclado y mouse. Pulsa " + KeyName(hotkeys[2]) + " para terminar.";
        }

        void TogglePlay(bool fromButton)
        {
            if (playing)
            {
                playing = false;
                return;
            }
            if (Busy()) return;
            captureTarget = -1;
            if (events.Count == 0)
            {
                ShowInfo("No hay macro grabado. Pulsa " + KeyName(hotkeys[2]) + " para grabar uno.");
                return;
            }

            MacroEvent[] sequence = events.ToArray();
            int loops = ReadNumber(loopsBox, 1, 0, 100000);
            double rate = speed;
            int delay = fromButton ? 2000 : 0;

            playing = true;
            macroInfo.Text = (fromButton ? "Empieza en 2 segundos. " : "Reproduciendo. ") +
                KeyName(hotkeys[3]) + " lo detiene.";
            Thread worker = new Thread(delegate() { PlayLoop(sequence, loops, rate, delay); });
            worker.IsBackground = true;
            worker.Start();
        }

        void PlayLoop(MacroEvent[] sequence, int loops, double rate, int delay)
        {
            // Teclas y botones que el macro dejo presionados, para soltarlos si se detiene a medias.
            HashSet<ushort> keysDown = new HashSet<ushort>();
            uint buttonsDown = 0;

            timeBeginPeriod(1);
            try
            {
                WaitWhile(delay, 2);
                int done = 0;
                while (playing && (loops == 0 || done < loops))
                {
                    Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                    for (int i = 0; i < sequence.Length && playing; i++)
                    {
                        MacroEvent e = sequence[i];
                        long due = (long)(e.T / rate);
                        while (playing)
                        {
                            long left = due - sw.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                            if (left <= 0) break;
                            Thread.Sleep((int)Math.Min(left, 15));
                        }
                        if (!playing) break;

                        if (e.Kind == 0)
                        {
                            SetCursorPos(e.X, e.Y);
                        }
                        else if (e.Kind == 1)
                        {
                            SetCursorPos(e.X, e.Y);
                            SendMouse(e.Flags, e.Data);
                            bool isDown = (e.Flags == 0x0002 || e.Flags == 0x0008 || e.Flags == 0x0020);
                            bool isUp = (e.Flags == 0x0004 || e.Flags == 0x0010 || e.Flags == 0x0040);
                            if (isDown) buttonsDown |= e.Flags;
                            if (isUp) buttonsDown &= ~(e.Flags >> 1);
                        }
                        else if (e.Kind == 2)
                        {
                            SendMouse(0x0800, e.Data);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            SendKey(e.Vk, e.Scan, e.Flags);
                            if ((e.Flags & 0x0002) == 0) keysDown.Add(e.Vk); else keysDown.Remove(e.Vk);
                        }
                    }
                    done++;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                foreach (ushort vk in keysDown) SendKey(vk, 0, 0x0002);
                if ((buttonsDown & 0x0002) != 0) SendMouse(0x0004, 0);
                if ((buttonsDown & 0x0008) != 0) SendMouse(0x0010, 0);
                if ((buttonsDown & 0x0020) != 0) SendMouse(0x0040, 0);
                timeEndPeriod(1);
                playing = false;
            }
        }

        static string MacroFile()
        {
            return Path.Combine(AppDir(), "macro.txt");
        }

        void SaveMacro()
        {
            if (recording || playing) return;
            if (events.Count == 0)
            {
                ShowInfo("No hay macro que guardar.");
                return;
            }
            try
            {
                List<string> lines = new List<string>();
                foreach (MacroEvent e in events)
                {
                    lines.Add(string.Join(";", new string[] {
                        e.Kind.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.T.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.X.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.Y.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.Flags.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.Data.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.Vk.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
                        e.Scan.ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) }));
                }
                File.WriteAllLines(MacroFile(), lines.ToArray());
                ShowInfo("Guardado en: " + MacroFile());
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowInfo("No se pudo guardar: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        void LoadMacro()
        {
            if (recording || playing) return;
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(MacroFile()))
                {
                    ShowInfo("No hay un macro guardado todavia.");
                    return;
                }
                List<MacroEvent> loaded = new List<MacroEvent>();
                foreach (string line in File.ReadAllLines(MacroFile()))
                {
                    string[] f = line.Split(';');
                    if (f.Length != 8) continue;
                    MacroEvent e = new MacroEvent();
                    e.Kind = int.Parse(f[0], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.T = long.Parse(f[1], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.X = int.Parse(f[2], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.Y = int.Parse(f[3], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.Flags = uint.Parse(f[4], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.Data = int.Parse(f[5], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.Vk = ushort.Parse(f[6], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    e.Scan = ushort.Parse(f[7], CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
                    loaded.Add(e);
                }
                events.Clear();
                events.AddRange(loaded);
                keepInfoUntil = DateTime.MinValue;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                ShowInfo("No se pudo cargar: " + ex.Message);
            }
        }

        // ---------- Captura global de teclado y mouse ----------
        delegate IntPtr HookProc(int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);
        HookProc keyProc, mouseProc;
        IntPtr keyHook = IntPtr.Zero, mouseHook = IntPtr.Zero;

        IntPtr OnKey(int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
        {
            if (nCode >= 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    int msg = wParam.ToInt32();
                    int vk = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam);
                    int scan = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 4);
                    int flags = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 8);
                    bool injected = (flags & 0x10) != 0;
                    bool down = (msg == 0x100 || msg == 0x104);

                    // Configurando un atajo o la tecla a pulsar: la siguiente tecla se queda como valor.
                    if (captureTarget >= 0 && down && !injected)
                    {
                        int target = captureTarget;
                        captureTarget = -1;
                        if (vk != 0x1B)         // Esc cancela
                        {
                            if (target == 4)
                            {
                                pressVk = (ushort)vk;
                                pressScan = (ushort)scan;
                                pressExtended = (flags & 0x01) != 0;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                bool taken = false;
                                for (int j = 0; j < hotkeys.Length; j++)
                                {
                                    if (j != target && hotkeys[j] == vk) taken = true;
                                }
                                if (!taken)
                                {
                                    hotkeys[target] = vk;
                                    hotkeyHeld[target] = true;      // no dispararlo con esta misma pulsacion
                                    SaveSettings();
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        RefreshUi();
                        return new IntPtr(1);   // la tecla no llega a otros programas
                    }

                    int hotkey = -1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < hotkeys.Length; i++)
                    {
                        if (hotkeys[i] == vk) hotkey = i;
                    }

                    if (hotkey >= 0)
                    {
                        if (!injected)
                        {
                            if (down && !hotkeyHeld[hotkey])
                            {
                                hotkeyHeld[hotkey] = true;
                                if (hotkey == 0) ToggleClicker(false);
                                else if (hotkey == 1) ToggleKeys(false);
                                else if (hotkey == 2) ToggleRecord(false);
                                else TogglePlay(false);
                            }
                            else if (!down)
                            {
                                hotkeyHeld[hotkey] = false;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else if (recording && !injected)
                    {
                        MacroEvent e = new MacroEvent();
                        e.Kind = 3;
                        e.T = recWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;
                        e.Vk = (ushort)vk;
                        e.Scan = (ushort)scan;
                        e.Flags = (down ? 0u : 0x0002u) | ((flags & 0x01) != 0 ? 0x0001u : 0u);
                        events.Add(e);
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }
            return CallNextHookEx(IntPtr.Zero, nCode, wParam, lParam);
        }

        IntPtr OnMouse(int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam)
        {
            if (nCode >= 0 && recording)
            {
                try
                {
                    int msg = wParam.ToInt32();
                    int flags = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 12);
                    if ((flags & 0x01) == 0)        // se ignoran los eventos generados por programas
                    {
                        int x = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 0);
                        int y = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 4);
                        int data = Marshal.ReadInt32(lParam, 8);
                        long now = recWatch.ElapsedMilliseconds;

                        MacroEvent e = null;
                        if (msg == 0x200)
                        {
                            // Los movimientos se guardan como mucho cada 8 ms.
                            if (now - lastMoveAt >= 8)
                            {
                                lastMoveAt = now;
                                e = new MacroEvent();
                                e.Kind = 0;
                            }
                        }
                        else if (msg == 0x20A)
                        {
                            e = new MacroEvent();
                            e.Kind = 2;
                            e.Data = (short)((data >> 16) & 0xFFFF);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            uint button = 0;
                            if (msg == 0x201) button = 0x0002;
                            else if (msg == 0x202) button = 0x0004;
                            else if (msg == 0x204) button = 0x0008;
                            else if (msg == 0x205) button = 0x0010;
                            else if (msg == 0x207) button = 0x0020;
                            else if (msg == 0x208) button = 0x0040;
                            else if (msg == 0x20B) button = 0x0080;
                            else if (msg == 0x20C) button = 0x0100;
                            if (button != 0)
                            {
                                e = new MacroEvent();
                                e.Kind = 1;
                                e.Flags = button;
                                if (button == 0x0080 || button == 0x0100) e.Data = (data >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
                            }
                        }

                        if (e != null)
                        {
                            e.T = now;
                            e.X = x;
                            e.Y = y;
                            events.Add(e);
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception) { }
            }
            return CallNextHookEx(IntPtr.Zero, nCode, wParam, lParam);
        }

        // ---------- Envio de clics y teclas ----------
        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        struct MOUSEINPUT
        {
            public int dx;
            public int dy;
            public uint mouseData;
            public uint dwFlags;
            public uint time;
            public IntPtr dwExtraInfo;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        struct KEYBDINPUT
        {
            public ushort wVk;
            public ushort wScan;
            public uint dwFlags;
            public uint time;
            public IntPtr dwExtraInfo;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
        struct InputUnion
        {
            [FieldOffset(0)] public MOUSEINPUT mi;
            [FieldOffset(0)] public KEYBDINPUT ki;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        struct INPUT
        {
            public uint type;
            public InputUnion u;
        }

        static void SendMouse(uint flags, int data)
        {
            INPUT[] input = new INPUT[1];
            input[0].type = 0;
            input[0].u.mi.dwFlags = flags;
            input[0].u.mi.mouseData = unchecked((uint)data);
            SendInput(1, input, Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(INPUT)));
        }

        static void SendKey(ushort vk, ushort scan, uint flags)
        {
            INPUT[] input = new INPUT[1];
            input[0].type = 1;
            input[0].u.ki.wVk = vk;
            input[0].u.ki.wScan = scan;
            input[0].u.ki.dwFlags = flags;
            SendInput(1, input, Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(INPUT)));
        }

        [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
        static extern uint SendInput(uint count, INPUT[] inputs, int size);

        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        static extern bool SetCursorPos(int x, int y);

        [DllImport("user32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
        static extern IntPtr SetWindowsHookEx(int idHook, HookProc lpfn, IntPtr hMod, uint dwThreadId);

        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        static extern bool UnhookWindowsHookEx(IntPtr hhk);

        [DllImport("user32.dll")]
        static extern IntPtr CallNextHookEx(IntPtr hhk, int nCode, IntPtr wParam, IntPtr lParam);

        [DllImport("kernel32.dll", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        static extern IntPtr GetModuleHandle(string lpModuleName);

        [DllImport("winmm.dll")]
        static extern uint timeBeginPeriod(uint period);

        [DllImport("winmm.dll")]
        static extern uint timeEndPeriod(uint period);

        [STAThread]
        public static void Main()
        {
            Application app = new Application();
            app.Run(new MainWindow());
        }
    }
